Name: Shops Open Longer for Self Serve mods
Author: CyanFire
Description:
Adds configurable opening times of shops so they are open longer, only really applies for certain shops prior to obtaining the Key To The Town. NPC schedules are not changed in any way, as such this is designed to be paired with Self Serve mods such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20985]Self Serve for 1.6[/url] to allow more shopping time. Opening times on the town map & signs around the town automatically update to reflect the changes. There is also a config option to allow Pierre to open on Wednesdays permanently & for shops to open on festival days (not when attending festival).


All languages supported

If there are any translation errors, please let me know!


SVE compatible



Default Opening Times:

Clint: 8:00am-5:00pm
Marnie: 8:00am-8:00pm
Pierre: 7:30am-9:00pm (Still closes on Wednesdays prior to Community Center completion unless PierreOpenWednesdays is enabled in config)
Robin: 8:00am-8:00pm
Hospital: 7:30am-4:30pm
Adventure Guild: 11:00am-2:00am
Willy: 7:00am-7:00pm
JojaMart: 7:00am-1:00am
Museum: 7:00am-8:00pm
Saloon: 10:00am-2:00am
Oasis: 7:00am-1:50am
Wizard: 6:00am-1:00am
